import json, subprocess, sys, random
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

def run(reqs):
    data = b"\n".join(json.dumps(r).encode() for r in reqs)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/app/submission/main.py"],input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=180)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        print("RC",p.returncode,p.stderr.decode()); sys.exit(1)
    return [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]

def expected_sums(inputs):
    P=len(inputs); R=len(inputs[0]) if P else 0; D=len(inputs[0][0]) if R else 0
    out=[]
    for q in range(R):
        v=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            for i in range(D): v[i]+=inputs[r][q][i]
        out.append(v)
    return out,P,R,D

def is_safe(st,inputs,P,R,D,exp):
    for r in range(P):
        for q,vec in enumerate(st["delivered"][r]):
            if vec!=exp[q]: return False
    for s in st["slots"]:
        q=s["seq"]; acc=[0]*D
        for rr in s["ranks"]:
            for i in range(D): acc[i]+=inputs[rr][q][i]
        if acc!=s["sum"]: return False
    return True

def is_done(st,P,R):
    return all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))

def walk(start, ids, edges):
    cur=start; states=[start]
    for eid in ids:
        if eid==-1:
            states.append(cur); continue
        if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return None
        s,a,t=edges[eid]
        if s!=cur: return None
        cur=t; states.append(cur)
    return cur,states

def check(req,resp):
    P=len(req["inputs"]); R=len(req["inputs"][0]) if P else 0; D=len(req["inputs"][0][0]) if R else 0
    exp,_,_,_=expected_sums(req["inputs"])
    states=req["states"]; edges=req["edges"]; start=req["start"]
    n=len(states)
    done=[is_done(st,P,R) for st in states]
    safe=[is_safe(st,req["inputs"],P,R,D,exp) for st in states]
    # safety
    if resp["safe"]:
        if resp["safety"] is not None: return "safe true but safety nonnull"
    else:
        w=resp["safety"]
        if w is None: return "safe false no witness"
        r=walk(start,w["prefix"],edges)
        if r is None: return "bad safety prefix walk"
        end,stts=r
        if safe[end]: return "safety ends safe"
    # liveness
    if resp["terminates"]:
        if resp["liveness"] is not None: return "term true liveness nonnull"
    else:
        w=resp["liveness"]
        if w is None: return "term false no witness"
        r=walk(start,w["prefix"],edges)
        if r is None: return "bad live prefix"
        mid,pref_states=r
        if any(done[s] for s in pref_states): return "prefix visits done"
        loop=w["loop"]
        if not loop: return "empty loop"
        r2=walk(mid,loop,edges)
        if r2 is None: return "bad loop walk"
        end2,loop_states=r2
        if end2!=mid: return "loop not closed"
        if any(done[s] for s in loop_states): return "loop visits done"
        # fairness
        Su=set(loop_states)
        # enabled using explicit edges from state
        en={}
        for a in set([f["action"] for f in req["fairness"]]):
            en[a]=set(e[0] for e in edges if e[1]==a)
        # actions occurring in loop (explicit edges only)
        used=set()
        for eid in loop:
            if eid!=-1: used.add(edges[eid][1])
        for f in req["fairness"]:
            a=f["action"]; es=en[a]
            if f["mode"]=="weak":
                if Su<=es and a not in used: return "weak fairness violated %s"%a
            else:
                if (Su & es) and a not in used: return "strong fairness violated %s"%a
    return None

random.seed(999)
bad=0;tot=0
for trial in range(2000):
    P=random.randint(1,2); R=random.randint(1,3); D=random.randint(0,2)
    inputs=[[[random.randint(-2,2) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(R)] for _ in range(P)]
    exp,_,_,_=expected_sums(inputs)
    n=random.randint(1,7)
    states=[]
    for i in range(n):
        delivered=[]
        for r in range(P):
            ln=random.randint(0,R)
            arr=[list(exp[q]) if random.random()<0.85 else [random.randint(-4,4) for _ in range(D)] for q in range(ln)]
            delivered.append(arr)
        states.append({"delivered":delivered,"slots":[]})
    edges=[];seen=set()
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,14)):
        s=random.randrange(n);t=random.randrange(n);a=random.choice(["a","b","c","d"])
        if (s,a,t) in seen: continue
        seen.add((s,a,t));edges.append([s,a,t])
    start=random.randrange(n)
    fair=[];used=set()
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,4)):
        a=random.choice(["a","b","c","d"])
        if a in used: continue
        used.add(a);fair.append({"action":a,"mode":random.choice(["weak","strong"])})
    req={"op":"audit","inputs":inputs,"states":states,"edges":edges,"start":start,"fairness":fair}
    resp=run([req])[0]
    err=check(req,resp)
    tot+=1
    if err:
        bad+=1
        print("BAD",err);print(json.dumps(req));print(json.dumps(resp))
        if bad>5:break
print("tot",tot,"bad",bad)
